name: Fleet
description: You serve as crew aboard the interplanetary and interstellar spacecraft of the Grand Imperial Fleet. Males fly and fire; females maintain the machinery that keeps the ships alive.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.description: You fly anything from a swift courier to a massive capital ship.

gunner.name: Gunner
gunner.description: You man a turret or other weapon, destroying enemy ships or disabling them so their crews can be enslaved.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.description: You maintain the systems of a starship despite a scarcity of spare parts and constant need for damage control.

crew.name: Crew
crew.description: You serve as a shipboard labourer or deckhand.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A superior officer has you demoted. Reduce Rank by −1 and gain a Rival. You are not ejected from this career.
mishaps.3: You are infected by an alien parasite. Roll END 8+; if you succeed, you do not lose any END; otherwise lose END −1. You are not ejected from this career.
mishaps.4: You are accused of smuggling illegal goods into Empire space. Lose SOC −2 and you are ejected from the career. You may only enter the Landless One or Outlaw career.
mishaps.5: You run afoul of your commanding officer. Lose SOC −1 and one Benefit roll. You are not ejected from the career.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table. Receive a combat implant and return to service next term.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your vessel is attacked by a Hierate clan ship. Roll either Pilot 8+, Gunner 8+, or Mechanic 8+. If you succeed, you drive off the attackers and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll. If you fail, the Hierate dogs damage your ship. Lose all Benefit rolls for this term.
events.4: You are sent on an operation to retrieve black market goods from a Hierate port. Roll Admin or Deception 8+. Succeed and gain 3 Benefit rolls. Fail and suffer DM−3 to your next Advancement roll.
events.5: You are considered for promotion to the officer caste. You may add the number of terms served in this career as a DM if you attempt to qualify for the Fleet Officer career next term.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to increase any one skill you already have by one level.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You serve as a crewmember on a mercenary cruiser or commerce raider and are exposed to foreign worlds and cultures. Gain a level of Language, Streetwise or Tolerance.
events.9: You are engaged in a series of vicious battles against the Hierate. You may demonstrate heroism or prudence in battle. If you demonstrate heroism, roll DEX 9+ to avoid rolling on the Injury table, and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll. If you cower, roll Stealth 8+ to avoid losing SOC −1.
events.10: The captain sees you as a promising crewman and entrusts you with an important ceremonial duty. Either gain a level in Steward or DM+4 to any Advancement roll thanks to his aid.
events.11: You serve under a hero of the Empire. Either gain a level in Tactics (Naval) if male or Admin if female, or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: Your efforts strike a great blow for the Empire. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
